title: ConsensusRun.v1
description: A multi-model / multi-run aggregation of LLM proposals for ONE decision step. CRITICAL SEMANTICS: a ConsensusRun is an EVIDENCE / AMBIGUITY signal, NOT a source of truth. agreement_score and disagreement_clusters describe how much the models agreed — they do NOT decide the answer. The final_label MUST come from a deterministic validator or an AdjudicationRecord (label_source ∈ {deterministic_validator, adjudication, authority_policy}); label_source can NEVER be 'consensus' or 'majority'. The boolean consensus_only_is_not_truth is pinned true so a downstream gate can assert 'consensus alone cannot serve a fact'. Low agreement_score routes to review/validator, it does not auto-promote. Deterministic when created_at is injected.

consensus_run_id.description: content-addressed id (sha256 over the sorted per-model outputs + step identity); deterministic

per_model_outputs.description: one entry per participating model/run; the raw material the agreement score is computed over

llm_trace_id.description: link to the LLMTrace for this model's proposal

agreement_score.description: 0.0..1.0 share of models agreeing on the modal proposal; a SIGNAL, not the answer

disagreement_clusters.description: groups of models that proposed the same distinct answer; surfaces ambiguity

final_label.description: the decision recorded for this step — produced by label_source (validator/adjudication/authority), NOT by majority vote

label_source.description: WHO produced final_label; can NEVER be 'consensus' or 'majority'. Consensus is evidence only.

consensus_only_is_not_truth.description: structurally pinned true: consensus alone can never serve a fact; a downstream gate asserts this

routed_to_review.description: true when agreement was low / ambiguous and the step was sent to a deterministic validator or human review rather than auto-decided

adjudication_record_id.description: link to the AdjudicationRecord, when label_source=adjudication

source_handles.description: handles grounding the final_label (which comes from the authority, not the votes)
